operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Updates an existing requisition (identified by its id) and its line items.

The body uses the nested-model convention: a `Requisition` object plus a `RequisitionItem` array, exactly like the create endpoint. On update no header field is strictly required — omitted fields such as `store_id`, `branch_id` and `number` keep / default from the existing record. Each line item still needs a `product_id` and a positive `quantity`.

Some fields are server-managed: a requisition whose status is *Under Delivery* is promoted to *Accepted* on edit, and `number` is generated automatically when left empty.

**Success response** is `{ "status": true, "id": <id> }` at HTTP `200` (add `extended` to also receive the saved record under `data`). A failure to save returns `{ "status": false, "message": "Couldn't update Requisition" }`, also at HTTP 200.

Editing is rejected with `403` for POS / stocktaking requisitions, for a requisition that has expense distribution attached, or for a requisition belonging to another branch.

parameters.name: extended
parameters.description: When present, the success response also includes the saved record under `data`.

Requisition.description: The requisition header. On update, omitted fields keep / default from the existing record.

type.description: Stock effect. `1` Inbound (adds stock), `2` Outbound (deducts stock), `3` Manual Transfer (no net effect).

order_type.description:
Origin / nature of the requisition.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Manual Inbound |
| 2 | Manual Outbound |
| 3 | Invoice |
| 4 | Refund Receipt |
| 5 | Credit Note |
| 6 | Purchase Invoice |
| 7 | Purchase Refund |
| 8 | Manual Transfer |
| 11 | POS Inbound |
| 12 | POS Outbound |
| 13 | Stocktaking Out |
| 14 | Stocktaking In |
| 15 | Purchase Debit Note |
| 16 | Manufacturing Order Returned Materials |
| 18 | Manufacturing Order Materials Outbound |
| 21 | Manufacturing Order Scrap Inbound |
| 22 | Manufacturing Order Product Inbound |
| 23 | Manual Import Inbound |
| 24 | Manual Import Outbound |
| 25 | Sales Order |

store_id.description: Source warehouse id. Defaults to the existing value when omitted.

to_store_id.description: Destination warehouse id (transfer requisitions only). If supplied, must be active and different from `store_id`.

date.description: Requisition date (account date format). Must fall in an open accounting period when the requisition is not pending.

number.description: Requisition number. Generated automatically when left empty.

attachment.description: Comma-separated attachment file ids. Must be a string — sending an array is rejected with HTTP 400.

draft.description: Set to `1` to save as a draft; cost-center validation is skipped for drafts.

RequisitionItem.description: Line items. Send the full set of items the requisition should have after the update.

id.description: Existing line item id (omit for new lines).

quantity.description: Quantity. Must be greater than zero.

cost_center_id.description: Cost center id. Required per line when cost-center distribution is enabled and the requisition is not a draft.

200.description: Requisition updated. Returns `{status:true, id}` (plus `data` when `extended` is sent). A failure to save returns `{status:false, message:"Couldn't update Requisition"}` with the same HTTP 200 status.

data.description: Only present when the `extended` flag is sent. Contains the saved requisition and its line items.

400.description: A line item has a quantity of zero or less, or `attachment` was sent as an array instead of a comma-separated string.

403.description: The authenticated user lacks `requisition modify` permission, or the requisition cannot be edited: it is a POS / stocktaking requisition, it has expense distribution attached, or it belongs to another branch.

404.description: No requisition with this id exists.
